Plugin.Name: DS-SC5B UAS Arbiter
Plugin.Overview: Run all five bays of a Sabrent DS-SC5B USB enclosure in your Unraid array without UAS aborts, USB resets and stalls during parity checks and rebuilds, and without disabling UAS. The DS-SC5B's two cascaded VIA VL822 hubs lose data-ready notifications when its upstream bay and three or more downstream bays transfer at once; this plugin loads uas_arb, a patched copy of the kernel's uas driver that schedules the bays so that combination never happens. Only the DS-SC5B bridges (ASMedia ASM235CM behind a VL822) are moved to it, before the array starts; other USB disks keep the stock driver. A module for your exact Unraid kernel is downloaded from GitHub (auto-built for every release from 7.0) and verified by SHA-256. After installing, reboot, then raise md_num_stripes (32768) in Settings, Disk Settings. Settings and live counters: Settings, User Utilities, DS-SC5B UAS Arbiter.
